title: USPS Change of Address Weekly Processing Time Trend
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=usps:change processing_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(processing_days) as avg_duration, max(processing_days) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst processing time for USPS change of address events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture processing_days on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average processing time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether USPS change of address tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
